notes.text: Security update for webkit2gtk3
notes.title: Title of the patch

notes.text:
This update for webkit2gtk3 fixes the following issue:

Security fixes:  

- CVE-2024-4367,CVE-2026-39872,CVE-2026-43663,CVE-2026-43676,CVE-2026-43699,CVE-2026-43701,
  CVE-2026-43705,CVE-2026-43707,CVE-2026-43712,CVE-2026-43713,CVE-2026-43715,CVE-2026-43716,
  CVE-2026-43720,CVE-2026-43721,CVE-2026-43725,CVE-2026-43726,CVE-2026-43727,CVE-2026-43731,
  CVE-2026-43732,CVE-2026-43734,CVE-2026-43740,CVE-2026-43742,CVE-2026-43745:
  WebKitGTK and WPE WebKit Security Advisory WSA-2026-0004 (bsc#1271638).

Other fixes:

- Update to version 2.52.5 (bsc#1271638):
 + Fire scrollend event for instant programmatic scrolls.
 + Increase network idle connection timeout to 115 seconds.
 + Add User-Agent quirk for HBO Max.
 + Fix the build with system malloc.
 + Fix several crashes and rendering issues.
